Name: Withings Disconnection: user can disconnect Withings device and Connect button is restored
Description: Click Disconnect in device management and verify the device card reverts to showing the Connect button

Name: Withings Weight Display: synced weight value of 70 appears on health dashboard
Description: After sync, the weight widget must display exactly '70' matching the value pushed to Withings

Name: Withings Sync Timestamp: last sync time is within tolerance of current IST time
Description: Verify the last sync timestamp shown on the device card is within 632 minutes of current IST time

Name: Withings Data Sync: manual sync pulls latest data from Withings device
Description: Click the Sync button in device management, return to Health tab, and confirm the page is ready after sync

Name: Withings OAuth Connection: user can connect Withings account via OAuth flow
Description: Verify the complete Withings OAuth authorization flow: Manage → Connect → email → password → Allow → redirected back to Health
